Jest has renamed or moved some of its functions. The old names keep working for a while and then get removed, so a test that uses one breaks on a later upgrade.

`--fix` writes the new name.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jest/no-deprecated-functions" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad {"count": 2} */}
```ts
import { jest } from "@jest/globals";

jest.useFakeTimers();
jest.runTimersToTime(1000);

const api = jest.genMockFromModule("./api");
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
import { jest } from "@jest/globals";

jest.useFakeTimers();
jest.advanceTimersByTime(1000);

const api = jest.createMockFromModule("./api");
```

The full list:

| Reported | From Jest | Write instead |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jest.resetModuleRegistry` | 15 | `jest.resetModules` |
| `jest.addMatchers` | 17 | `expect.extend` |
| `require.requireMock` | 21 | `jest.requireMock` |
| `require.requireActual` | 21 | `jest.requireActual` |
| `jest.runTimersToTime` | 22 | `jest.advanceTimersByTime` |
| `jest.genMockFromModule` | 26 | `jest.createMockFromModule` |

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `jest.version` | `"29"` | Your Jest version, as a string. A function is only reported starting from the version in the table above. |

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"jest/no-deprecated-functions" = ["error", { jest = { version = "25.1.0" } }]
```

`jest.genMockFromModule` is still the current name in Jest 25:

{/* good {"options": [{"jest": {"version": "25.1.0"}}]} */}
```ts
import { jest } from "@jest/globals";

const api = jest.genMockFromModule("./api");
```

If you set `settings.jest.version` (`[lint.settings.jest]` in `bunfig.toml`, or `settings` in an ESLint or oxlint config), that version is used instead of the option.
